headline: 994 hospitalised in 24 hours as 3 more die of dengue
summary: The death toll from dengue this year has risen to 85, with nearly 30,000 total cases reported across Bangladesh.
details: At least three dengue patients died and 994 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours leading up to 8:00am today, according to the DGHS.
Of the three deaths, two occurred in Dhaka South City Corporation and one in Dhaka North City Corporation.
With these latest figures, the total death toll from dengue this year has risen to 85.
The total number of cases reported this year has now reached 29,923.
Currently, 2,080 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at various hospitals across the country.
caption:
994 people hospitalised in just 24 hours. Dengue continues to claim lives across Bangladesh.

At least three dengue patients died and 994 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours leading up to 8:00am today, according to the DGHS.

Of the three deaths, two occurred in Dhaka South City Corporation and one in Dhaka North City Corporation.

With these latest figures, the total death toll from dengue this year has risen to 85.

The total number of cases reported this year has now reached 29,923.

Currently, 2,080 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at various hospitals across the country.

headline: Nusrat murder: HC confirms 2 death sentences, 4 get life imprisonment
summary: The High Court has upheld the death penalties for Siraj Uddaula and Shahadat Hossain Shamim in the brutal killing of madrasa student Nusrat Jahan Rafi.
details: The High Court has upheld the death sentences of Siraj Uddaula, the dismissed principal of Sonagazi Islamia Fazil Madrasa, and Shahadat Hossain Shamim in the Nusrat Jahan Rafi murder case.
caption:
Two men face the gallows after the High Court upholds their death sentences for the brutal murder of madrasa student Nusrat Jahan Rafi.

The High Court has upheld the death sentences of Siraj Uddaula, the dismissed principal of Sonagazi Islamia Fazil Madrasa, and Shahadat Hossain Shamim in the Nusrat Jahan Rafi murder case.

#NusratJahanRafi #Justice #Bangladesh #HighCourt #Feni

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo, The Daily Star
